notes: All-in-one 136" direct-view micro-LED display (1920x1080, 16:9) with integrated 10-point multi-touch (MFT = multi-touch). Not rack-mountable — wall-mounted (included mount) or optional rolling floor stand. Port list and labels taken verbatim from the official Planar UltraRes L 136 Series User Manual (Part No. 020-1427-00C, "Planar UltraRes L Series – Standard Inputs" diagram, p.20) and the Specifications table (p.138-140). HDMI 1/HDMI 2 are HDMI 2.0 with HDCP 2.2; HDMI 3/HDMI 4 are HDMI 1.4 with HDCP 1.4 (only one HDCP 2.2 source can display at a time). DP OUT only mirrors DP IN content, cannot pass through any HDMI input. AC IN is labeled "IEC C20" on the unit's connector panel (the C20 is the male-pin panel inlet that mates with a C19 cord connector); modeled here as iec-c19 per the closest available connector id since a dedicated "iec-c20" id is not in the allowed list. RS232 is DB9 female for external/serial control. IR input is a 3.5mm TRS female jack for an external IR receiver eye (included accessory), not a full IR transceiver. USB-B is used for touch data and serial commands to a host PC; USB-A is listed as "Service" only (not a general-purpose host/media port) per the manual, but categorized bidirectional per USB-host convention. No separate power switch port modeled (AC ON/OFF is a physical rocker switch, not a connector). Audio: PC Line In is not a separate physical jack — HDMI/DP embed audio; the manual's Standard Inputs diagram does not show a dedicated analog line-in jack, only Line Audio Out (3.5mm TRS) and SPDIF Audio Out (Toslink). Grades: HDMI and DisplayPort versions confirmed directly from manual; RJ45/LAN speed not stated in manual (omitted grade, no eth speed specified — treated as unconfirmed rather than assumed 1G).
